## Summary

What changed, and why is this useful?

## Linked issue

Link the accepted issue (for example, `Closes #123`). Explain any scope changes.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Mark a check as not applicable when appropriate.

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run format:check`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` for TypeScript changes
- [ ] `bun run build` when build output may change
- [ ] Relevant web, API, or database tests
- [ ] Browser journey and screenshots or recording for UI changes

## Review

- [ ] I reviewed the final diff for unrelated edits, secrets, and private data.
- [ ] I checked contracts, permissions, migrations, and documentation affected by this change.

If AI agents helped, describe the implementation agent's work, whether a separate agent reviewed the final diff, and how review findings were resolved. See [the AI agent guide](https://github.com/Dityath/Wooble/blob/main/docs/ai-agents.md).

## Release and operational notes

Describe any configuration changes, database migrations, self-hosting upgrade steps, known limitations, or follow-up work. Write “None” when there are none.
